elements.requirement: Within the period of one month beginning with the date a landlord is given a notice under section 80, the landlord must supply the auditor with any document specified under section 80(3)(c)(i).
elements.quote: within the period of one month beginning with the date of the giving of the notice, he shall— (a) supply the auditor with any document specified under subsection (3)(c)(i) of that section

elements.requirement: Within the period of one month beginning with the date a landlord is given a notice under section 80, the landlord must afford the auditor, in respect of any document falling within section 79(2)(a)(ii), any facilities specified in relation to it under section 80(3)(c)(ii).
elements.quote: afford him, in respect of any document falling within section 79(2)(a)(ii), any facilities specified in relation to it under subsection (3)(c)(ii) of section 80

elements.requirement: Within the period of one month beginning with the date a landlord is given a notice under section 80, the landlord must, in the case of every other document or description of documents specified in the notice under section 80(3)(c)(ii), either afford the auditor facilities for inspection or taking copies or extracts, or give the auditor a notice stating that the landlord objects to doing so for reasons specified in that notice.
elements.quote: in the case of every other document or description of documents specified in the notice under subsection (3)(c)(ii) of that section, either— (i) afford the auditor facilities for inspection or (as the case may be) taking copies or extracts in respect of that document or those documents, or (ii) give the auditor a notice stating that he objects to doing so for such reasons as are specified in the notice

elements.requirement: If a date is specified in a notice under section 80(3)(d), the landlord must, within one month beginning with the date of the giving of the notice, either approve that date or propose another date for carrying out an inspection under section 79(4).
elements.quote: if a date is specified in the notice under subsection (3)(d) of that section, either approve the date or propose another date for the carrying out of an inspection under section 79(4)

elements.requirement: Any date proposed by the landlord for an inspection under section 79(4) must be a date falling not later than the end of the period of two months beginning with the date of the giving of the notice under section 80.
elements.quote: Any date proposed by the landlord under subsection (1)(c) must be a date falling not later than the end of the period of two months beginning with the date of the giving of the notice under section 80

elements.requirement: Where a relevant person is given a notice under section 79 requiring the provision of facilities for inspection or taking copies or extracts of documents, that relevant person must, within one month beginning with the date of the giving of the notice, either afford the auditor the required facilities or give the auditor a notice stating an objection for specified reasons.
elements.quote: Where a relevant person is given a notice under section 79 requiring him to afford the auditor facilities for inspection or taking copies or extracts in respect of any documents or description of documents specified in the notice, then within the period of one month beginning with the date of the giving of the notice, he shall, in the case of every such document or description of documents, either— (a) afford the auditor the facilities required by him; or (b) give the auditor a notice stating that he objects to doing so for such reasons as are specified in the notice

elements.requirement: If the landlord or relevant person fails to comply with any requirement of a notice under section 80 or section 79 by the end of two months beginning with the date of the giving of the notice, the court may, on the application of the auditor, make an order requiring compliance within a period specified in the order.
elements.quote: If by the end of the period of two months beginning with— (a) the date of the giving of the notice under section 80, or (b) the date of the giving of such a notice under section 79 as is mentioned in subsection (3) above, the landlord or (as the case may be) a relevant person has failed to comply with any requirement of the notice, the court may, on the application of the auditor, make an order requiring the landlord or (as the case may be) the relevant person to comply with that requirement within such period as is specified in the order

elements.requirement: The court must not make an order requiring compliance in respect of any document or documents unless it is satisfied that the document or documents fall within paragraph (a) or (b) of section 79(2).
elements.quote: The court shall not make an order under subsection (4) in respect of any document or documents unless it is satisfied that the document or documents falls or fall within paragraph (a) or (b) of section 79(2)

elements.requirement: If no inspection under section 79(4) has been carried out by the auditor by the end of two months beginning with the date of the giving of the notice under section 80, the court may, on the application of the auditor, make an order providing for such an inspection to be carried out on a date specified in the order.
elements.quote: If by the end of the period of two months specified in subsection (2) no inspection under section 79(4) has been carried out by the auditor, the court may, on the application of the auditor, make an order providing for such an inspection to be carried out on such date as is specified in the order

elements.requirement: An auditor's application for an order requiring compliance or providing for an inspection must be made before the end of the period of four months beginning with the date of the giving of the notice under section 80 or the relevant notice under section 79.
elements.quote: Any application for an order under subsection (4) or (6) must be made before the end of the period of four months beginning with— (a) in the case of an application made in connection with a notice given under section 80, the date of the giving of that notice; or (b) in the case of an application made in connection with such a notice under section 79 as is mentioned in subsection (3) above, the date of the giving of that notice
